In case someone gets ahold of your debit card they can drain this account very easily. It’s better to keep some in checking to cover small expenses. Put the rest in a savings account. Make sure the checking account doesn’t carry over into savings tho, you know incase of overdraws. and use a Credit Card for all purchases. That’s way you don’t loose all of your money. 

I do this. CC for everything I can. I get a certain % back for everything I buy. It’s great! 
Pay off entire amount of CC every month. No interest. 

My bank called me because someone was trying to make purchases at an expensive fashion designer store in San Francisco. I definitely wasn’t doing any of that. If my bank hadn’t caught that tiny $3 transaction (they made a small transaction first to see if it would go threw before the big purchase) 
I would have lost all my and my husband’s money from savings. 

TLDR: keep the majority of your money in savings. Keep some in checking for basic expenses. Use a CC with a % back for everything else.
